Keep its compact head form with no new body, limbs, hands or costume. A gentle tilt, eye direction or slight expression variation is allowed. Same premium 'Keramik & Licht' craftsmanship, not flat graphics, not a smoother generic toy, not a new animal design. Palette: deep forest green, sage, ivory, restrained amber accent. All objects fully contained with generous margins. Mascot is the main figure, comparable size throughout the set, about 650-730px tall in 1536x1024.
